required_gates.contract: Validate exact ids 00..60, exact names, exact order and canonical count; reject P360-00 or invented names.
Detect cloned/generic section payloads and identical required_fields where registry function differs.
Require sufficient section-specific materialization: values, trace, QA, sidecar and fallback.
Validate every official TechExt required field, not only module count.
Agent-loaded per-model file must contain/materialize the FULL profile, not a summary beside a JSON full elsewhere.
Compute fullness metrics: sections, TechExt fields, anchors, source trace, sidecars, QA/fallback, field_count, parity mapping/hash.
Validate 10 runtime core files have distinct domains and similarity avg <= 0.80.
Both ChatGPT and Copilot project configs must be exactly 8000 chars and contain required controls.
Coverage map must trace model -> Profile360 section/field/subfield -> TechExt module/field -> anchors/source/runtime/sidecar/QA/fail/fallback/evidence.
0 validators_fail is invalid unless all deep validators exist and PASS with concrete actual_value.
Simple/colloquial prompts trigger the same full output and validation contract.
Project updates/migrations apply the same deep gates and cannot preserve previous structural errors.
Model data updates recalculate dependent Profile360, TechExt, anchors, alias, coverage, hashes and runtime.
Motor updates preserve prior layers and run simple project generation regression against Project Factory.
No DELIVERY_ALLOWED if any deep validator is missing, actual_value empty, PASS by count, known independent equivalent fail, or contract gate fail.
Counts are evidence hints only; exact contract PASS is mandatory.
